page.layout: One page of names in two parallel columns (left: Bernhardus Grues etc.; right: Bocco Awema etc.), with the year printed in the right margin beside each group of lines. Below them, a decorative ornament, then the heading "IN CAMERA RATIONVM." and two columns headed "Oppidani." (left) and "Agrarij." (right), each with its years in the right margin. Page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: Eggricus Eggeus Phebes. | Ioannes Clant Warfhusius.
main_text.head: IN CAMERA RATIONVM.

page.notes: The ornament between the upper and lower sections is decorative and not transcribed. Years in the right margin: 1502, 1608 (possibly 1603), 1604, 1596, 1597, 1598, 1599. The third-to-last year is read as 1598 and may be 1592 [?]; the last digit of 1608 and 1597 is uncertain. Several names have uncertain letters (Bocco Awema, Meckama, Warfhusius, Byma), marked as read from the scan. Catchword "Ioannes" is cut off at the page edge.
